readme.run: Measure bead PSF FWHM or field illumination uniformity (MetroloJ_QC)
notes: Input is a single-channel TIFF or OME-TIFF bead z-stack (PSF) or 2D slide image (field).
Analysis mode defaults to auto (psf for z-stacks, field for 2D images).
OME-XML optics and voxel sizes are read automatically; override with --na, --emission, etc.
No network connection is required and no external model files are downloaded.
Please cite Faklaris et al. 2022 (MetroloJ_QC, J Cell Biol 221:e202107093)
and Zipfel, Williams & Webb 2003 (Nat Biotechnol 21:1369) for multiphoton.
